addons.name: Pretendard JP
addons.author: Kil Hyung-jin
addons.description: A clean, highly legible sans-serif font family optimised for Japanese environments. Kana and kanji are scaled down 6.25 % to align with Latin glyphs, full-width punctuation and Japanese-specific symbols are included, and the design is built on Source Han Sans JP, M PLUS 1, and Inter — making it an ideal companion for Japanese, Korean, and Latin text on the same keyboard.
